messages: Hi, I am Dia, I am here to help you~
Long time no see, time passes with the blink of the eyes...
*Hammer your chest with my kitty fist*

5_7: Good morning! A beautiful new day is beginning.
Early-bird hours — set a tiny goal for today!
Fresh air, fresh mind — have a great start.
7_11: Good morning! How's your day going? Don't sit too long — stretch a bit.
Keep the momentum and sip some water.
A short walk can spark ideas.
11_13: It's noon — you've been working all morning.
Lunch time! Refuel and relax your eyes.
A power nap can work wonders.
13_17: Afternoon slump? A gentle stretch might help.
Tea or coffee — then keep going!
Remember to blink and rest your eyes.
17_19: It's evening! The sunset outside the window is beautiful.
Evening breeze feels nice — wrap up gently.
Give yourself a small pat on the back.
19_21: Good evening — how are you doing today?
Time to unwind and review today's wins.
Maybe a book or a playlist?
21_23: It's getting late — rest early, good night~
Take good care of your eyes!
Save and back up your work — tomorrow you will thank you.
24: Night-owl mode? Remember to rest soon.
Late hours can be quiet and magical — be kind to your eyes.
Make sure tomorrow-you will thank you.
